Bihar-Jharkhand Earthquake: pichhle kuchh mahinon ke dauran desh ke kaee hisson men bhukanp ke jhatke mahsus kie gae hain. arunachal se lekar himachal pradesh, uttarakhand, dilli-ensiaar aur maharashtr jaise rajyon men dharti doli hai. ab bihar aur jharkhand ke kaee jilon men bhukanp ke jhatke mahsus kie gae hain.
Bihar aur jharkhand ke taza khabron ke lie dekhte rahie News18 Bihar/Jharkhand
